messages:
olivia: Drafting a super-short 'two-line goal card' template for folks + a tiny hiring/okrs crossover prompt. Want something managers can read in 10s. PTAL.

olivia: TEMPLATE (copyable):
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q2 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 line): [outcome-focused sentence]
Why it matters (1 line): [customer / biz impact]
Top KR (1 line): [metric + target] (conf 0-10)
One-sentence plan (3 actions comma-separated, est effort S/M/L)
Manager ask (one line): [unblock/prioritize/hire - if hire, include role + urgency]
Self-review blurb (for cycle): 2 bullets per KR - 1) "what changed" 2) "evidence (metric/link)"

raj: Love the brevity. Add a 1-line hiring prompt when manager ask contains "hire" so HR has preferred wording.

taylor: propose micro-phrases for managers to use in calibration meetings (30s responses):
 - "Green: on track, no change"
 - "Amber: reduce scope or add headcount"
 - "Red: escalate blocker to execs"

olivia: hiring prompt example (auto-fill if manager ask contains hire): "Hiring request: role=Senior SWE, reason=KR delivery, ETA=Q3, blocker=capacity, must-hire=true"

people-ops-bot: FYI: We added a DM template for the two-line card -> /dm @peer "Tiny goal check: [paste card]". Handbook link -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/two-line-card :bookmark_tabs:

raj: For reviews, coaches can paste one-sentence feedback using this ladder: "Keep doing X" / "Stop doing Y" / "Start doing Z". Keeps feedback actionable and short.

olivia: I'll wire this into the goal packet and add an example for SWE/PM/hiring request. Will ping managers tomorrow for a 5-min demo. Thanks for quick takes :tada:
